build_kto_trainer: build a KTO trainer to align a causal language model using KTO loss with chosen and rejected completions
train_model_kto: train a language model with KTO alignment using a dataset of desirable and undesirable responses
compute_kto_loss: compute the KTO loss for a batch of policy and reference model log probabilities
tokenize_kto_dataset: tokenize a KTO-specific dataset with prompts and completions into separate prompt and answer token ids
prepare_kto_dataset: prepare a KTO dataset by extracting prompts, applying chat templates, tokenizing, and computing KL mismatch pairs
